title: SALAD-Bench: A Hierarchical and Comprehensive Safety Benchmark for Large Language Models
reasoning: The SALAD-Bench taxonomy includes 'Human Autonomy & Integrity Harms' as a core evaluation domain, which addresses ethical considerations like undermining individual choices and psychological well-being. The benchmark also covers other domains such as 'Misinformation Harms' and 'Malicious Use' which inherently deal with moral and ethical implications of LLM outputs. The evaluation framework is built around assessing the ethical safety of LLMs.
